plan.title: Award two-bid RFQ to L1 vendor

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids directly on Master QCS.
Ensure the required eRFX project configuration is enabled for the case.
Enter the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to the L1 vendor, Vendor B.
Verify one line is selected, exactly one of two vendors is awarded, and Vendor B's 10 × 90 allocation totals 900.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Fill any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal to finalize the award.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Create the purchase order from the submitted award and read the resulting PO.
Verify the PO contains the single awarded line with all 10 units.
